messages:
oliver: Heads up - AuroraBio wants an odd combo: run 2 POCs in parallel, pool credits into a single post-POC enterprise commit, and be able to reassign leftover credits between internal teams. Can we do that?
nina: Short answer: maybe. Long answer: transfers allowed only within the same BILLING_ENTITY. Cross-entity transfers = new contract.
courtney: Deal Desk: we can support pooled credits -> consolidated commit, but need an explicit mapping in the SOW CSV and a hard cap on transferable amount. Recommend max transferable = 50% of pooled credits unless exec okays exception.
alan: Ops: prefer metered + credited so we retain telemetry. If they want "no metering", we lose usage signals for sizing.
revops-bot: RevOps import format required: CSV with columns: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,POC_CREDIT_CAP,CREDIT_TRANSFERABLE_FLAG,CONSOLIDATE_TO_COMMIT_ID. Attach via /deal-request.
oliver: Customer specifically asked for a 120-day conversion window. Is that okay?
courtney: 120d is long but can be considered for strategic deals. Default is 90d; anything >90d needs VP approval and a reduced credit lifetime (we usually set CREDIT_EXPIRATION=90d even if conversion window is longer).
nina: Also need model-level rate notes. One POC uses Redwood-gn-xl (high token burn) and the other uses a quantized small model. The quote must include SKU multipliers or per-POC rate lines.
alan: Ops caveat: if both POCs reuse the same project/endpoint names, KV cache might give them effectively lower combined cost than estimated. Add disclosure in SOW.
courtney: Draft SOW snippet to include in /deal-request (put in code block):
```
BILLING_ENTITY=Aurora-Bio-Parent
POC_TAGS=AUR-POC-1,AUR-POC-2
POC_WINDOWS=2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31;2026-07-01 to 2026-08-15
POC_CREDIT=100% metered usage credited up to $40,000 per POC
CONSOLIDATED_COMMIT=If conversion within 120d apply up to $80,000/mo for 12 months
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=90d
TRANSFER_RULES=Credits transferable between business units under same BILLING_ENTITY up to 50% of pooled credits; transfers require CSV mapping and Deal Desk approval
MODEL_SKU_OVERRIDES=gn-xl:x1.8;quant-small:x0.5
```
courtney: I'll open the deal-request and route to Legal + VP for stacking/time-window exception. @oliver attach the CSV and estimated traffic by EOD.
legal-bot: Legal flag: credits are timeboxed and auditable; no cash refunds for committed fees; require right to audit POC usage prior to applying credits; any transferability must be limited to accounts under the same legal entity.
oliver: Thanks all — will confirm billing entity and upload CSV. Leaving this as the action list.
